content: A single swallow does not make a spring, nor does one sunny day make a season of flowers.
author: Ancient Greek Proverbs
sourceWork: Mia khelidon ear ou poiei (Μία χελιδὼν ἔαρ οὐ ποιεῖ) — Aristotle (Nicomachean Ethics I.7)
explanation: One virtuous act does not make a noble person; one profitable afternoon does not make a prosperous business; one peaceful morning does not make a sage. Excellence is not a singular, dramatic event, but the unyielding rhythm of consistent daily practice.
practicalInsight: Do not congratulate yourself into complacency after one good workout or one kind deed. Show up and repeat it tomorrow.
reflectionPrompt: Are you mistaking a single 'sunny day' of good intentions for the deep, sustained season of true discipline?
